$comment: Where each OpenAPI document in this directory came from. A Liferay openapi.json records nothing about the portal that served it, and scripts/validate-rest-paths.cjs treats these documents as the authoritative contract for the paths and methods this SDK sends to production - so a spec captured from the wrong DXP line is a gate that looks authoritative and silently is not. Written by scripts/sync-schemas.js; see LDM #61.
